title: Indices of Effect Existence and Significance in the Bayesian Framework
authors: Makowski, D., Ben-Shachar, M. S., Chen, S. H. A., & Lüdecke, D.
summary: There are several ways to say a Bayesian effect "exists" — the probability of direction, ROPE coverage, Bayes factors, MAP-based p-values — and they do not always agree. This paper compares them on simulated data, sets out which to report, and maps each onto the frequentist p-value researchers are arriving from.
